name: resume_screening
title: Resume screening (composite score)
what_it_tests: Evaluate fictional candidates against a job on separate dimensions (Python, APIs, SQL databases, cloud) so they can be combined with weights in code.

criteria: Only mentions it or took a course

apis.instructions: The candidate's experience building REST APIs
criteria: Designed and maintained APIs in production for years

sql_db.instructions: The candidate's experience with SQL databases

cloud.instructions: The candidate has cloud computing experience (AWS, Azure or GCP)
